verdict.rationale: OpenCode has a dedicated Agent Skills feature documented at opencode.ai/docs/skills/, letting users define reusable, on-demand instructions loaded via a native `skill` tool from repo or home directory, directly matching the custom-skills story. This is corroborated by first-party docs describing discovery and loading mechanics, though independent hands-on community validation specifically of skills (vs. subagents/MCP) is thin. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of the skills feature specifically, and richer docs on skill authoring/sharing workflows.
